takes.h: Kane Hodder's Jason Goes to Hell mask heads to Heritage Auctions
takes.p: Heritage Auctions is offering the screen-matched hockey mask Kane Hodder wore in Jason Goes to Hell: The Final Friday, iHorror reports. Lot 38578, which includes Hodder's signed, annotated February 18, 1992 first-draft script, is scheduled for December 2 in the November 30–December 3 Hollywood/Entertainment Signature Auction.
